versions.version: Identified during the 2026-10-27 review; not started.

Verified live with codex-cli 0.164.0 on 2026-11-02, scratch data root and throwaway repo under /tmp, no real data. Setup: `BOOF_RUNNER_DATA_ROOT=$S/data boof-runner run --file prompt.txt --repo $S/repo --tool codex --model gpt-6-luna --title steer-codex` (prompt: run `sleep 45`, then create a.txt containing a). While the sleep ran: `boof-runner tasks inject -d $S/data --project-id repo --task-id steer-codex --mode now --prompt "also create b.txt in the repository root containing the single line: b"` answered applied: pending. Run 1 steered the planner step, run 2 the developer step (injected at 18:04:03). Both: the log shows `### Steered` then `### Planner (steer 1)` / `### Developer (steer 1)`, the agent says the wait was interrupted, runs `sleep 45` again and `printf 'a\n' > a.txt && printf 'b\n' > b.txt`; the reviewer approved. Resume confirmed in ~/.codex/sessions: one rollout file holds the original prompt and the steer text and has two task_started turns, so `codex exec resume ` was used. Landing: the agent left the files uncommitted, so the runner committed a.txt and b.txt to boof-runner/steer-codex2--leftovers (6fbf022); the task branch itself stays at the base. Run 1 had told the agent to commit nothing and the reviewer deleted the untracked files, so only run 2 is evidence for the files. Found and fixed: `run --tool codex` without `--model` used the static default gpt-5.5, which this ChatGPT account refuses (model_not_found, the first attempt failed in the planner); toolOverride now takes the first model the tool lists (codex debug models), falling back to the default list; tests with a tool whose listModels differs from defaultModels. Not a defect: codex logs `ERROR codex_core::util: Custom tool call output is missing` after a steer (the killed command never returned).

tests.strategy: Manual live run against the codex CLI plus a unit test for the codex resume argument building.
